messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bengali, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bengali line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Bengali) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | Vedi | 2nd sg. imperative “see / behold” | দেখো | “see / behold” | OK | | la | Definite article (fem. sg.) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | “the beast” (object of Vedi) | দানবকে | “the beast (to‑object)” | OK | | per | Preposition “because of / for which” | যার জন্য | “for which / because of” | OK | | cu' | Relative pronoun “which” (dative/abl.) | যার | “which” | OK | | io | 1st sg. pronoun “I” | আমি | “I” | OK | | mi | Reflexive pronoun (self‑directed) | — (implicit in ঘুরে গেলাম) | — | UNNECESSARY | | volsi | “turned” (past historic) | ঘুরে গেলাম | “turned” | OK | | aiutami | 1st sg. imperative “help me” | আমাকে সাহায্য কর | “help me” | OK | | da | Preposition “against” | বিরুদ্ধে | “against” | OK | | lei | 3rd sg. fem. pronoun “her” | তার | “her” | OK | | famoso | Adjective “famous” | প্রখ্যাত | “famous” | OK | | saggio | Noun “sage” (vocative) | জ্ঞানী | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella | Conjunction + pronoun “that she / because she” | সে | “she” (conjoined with কারণ) | OK | | mi | 1st sg. pronoun “my” (object of fa) | আমার | “my” | OK | | fa | Causative verb “makes” | কাঁপিয়ে দেয় | “makes (cause to tremble)” | OK | | tremar | Infinitive “to tremble” | কাঁপিয়ে | “tremble (as part of causative)” | OK | | le | Definite article (fem. pl.) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | vene | Noun “veins” (pl.) | শিরা | “veins” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | ও | “and” | OK | | i | Definite article (masc. pl.) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | polsi | Noun “pulses” (pl.) | নাড়ি | “pulses” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, `mi` (reflexive), `le`, `i` – Bengali does not use articles or a separate reflexive pronoun here, so they are naturally omitted. - **WRONG**: End‑punctuation of line 90 – the source ends with `»` but the translation ends with the Bengali full stop `।`. This deviates from the rule to copy the source’s final punctuation.
All other lexical items are correctly rendered and grammatically appropriate.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bengali script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bengali text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- লাইন 88: - Original: দেখো সেই দানবকে যার জন্য আমি ঘুরে গেলাম; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - লাইন 89: - Original: প্রখ্যাত জ্ঞানী তার বিরুদ্ধে আমাকে সাহায্য কর, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - লাইন 90: - Original: কারণ সে আমার শিরা ও নাড়ি কাঁপিয়ে দেয়। - Issue: WRONG – ending punctuation should be the source’s closing quote “»” instead of the Bengali full stop “।”. - Corrected: কারণ সে আমার শিরা ও নাড়ি কাঁপিয়ে দেয়»
``` দেখো সেই দানবকে যার জন্য আমি ঘুরে গেলাম; প্রখ্যাত জ্ঞানী তার বিরুদ্ধে আমাকে সাহায্য কর, কারণ সে আমার শিরা ও নাড়ি কাঁপিয়ে দেয়» ```
